product_metadata.title: Zulay Ice Cream Scoop With Soft Easy Grip Handle - Ice Cream Scooper With Built-in Lid Opener - Heavy Duty Icecream Scoop With Non-Slip Handle For Soft & Hard Ice Cream (Black)
features: Know The Latest Scoop: No more wrestling your way into a container of stone-cold ice cream that was taken out directly from the freezer. Made with premium quality zinc alloy metal that is durable, sturdy, and heavy-duty. The Zulay Kitchen Ice Cream Scooper will carve its way into hard and frozen ice cream with no problem at all.

Make The Perfect Curl: The scooper is designed with a wide curve that guarantees a smooth and effortless glide that produces a well-proportioned scoop. Its thin and precise edges ensure that no ice cream will be left behind when you work your way around the sides, corner, or bottom of the ice cream container.

Easy To Maneuver: The handle is constructed with a thick rubber texture that is resistant to slippage, not to mention it provides great comfortability when force is used for scooping hard ice cream. What else is there to love? Forget about dealing with a stubborn lid — the handle is constructed with a notch in the bottom that lifts container lids effortlessly.

Versatile & Easy To Clean: For all the successful scooping to come, our scooper is thoughtfully designed with 5 interior grooves that release frozen ice cream easily. Satisfy your cold cravings every time with less effort. Dishwasher friendly or can be cleaned with a quick hand wash. Perfect gift for your loved ones, friends, colleagues, and more.

No Hassle, Zulay Guarantee: We love and take pride in our Ice Cream Scoop and we back this up with a lifetime guarantee. If there are ever any issues, just contact us and we will make it right. Order now and be assured that this product will live up to your expectations, guaranteed. If it does not, we got you covered (even after the Amazon return window). Chances are, you will never need to reach out!
